subject.title: fix(auth): allow OpenAI OAuth for audio transcription

question: Should OpenClaw officially support ChatGPT/Codex OAuth for native OpenAI `/audio/transcriptions`, rather than keeping batch audio transcription API-key-only?
rationale: The patch can be mechanically reviewed, but the supported provider credential and billing/entitlement contract is a user-facing product policy that source inspection cannot establish alone.

options.title: Approve native-only OAuth support
options.body: Accept the endpoint-gated OAuth contract after final-head successful live proof and matching provider documentation.

options.title: Retain API-key-only audio
options.body: Keep the existing audio credential policy and decline the new OAuth exception unless an upstream-supported contract is established.

recommendation.title: Approve native-only OAuth support
recommendation.body: Accept the endpoint-gated OAuth contract after final-head successful live proof and matching provider documentation.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged audio-auth policy is the closest current-main ownership signal for this credential-contract decision.
